sources.allowed: f16net-aim9, f16net-aim120, f16net-jdam, f16net-mk82, f16net-tanks, usaf-600, ter-9a, l3h-bru57, inferred

notes.lateral_limit_kgm: the F-16's maximum allowable asymmetric (rolling) moment, 25,020 ft-lb (3,459 kg·m), as a forum quotes the flight manual's stores limitations (bms-asym; the manual itself not seen, so inferred); the Sufa's and the Barak's taken the same (inferred)
notes.lateral_limit_hard: false: the briefing warns and lets the jet fly (the manual forbids the take-off only when the roll trim cannot hold the moment, which the briefing does not know)
notes.allowed: the stores each station takes, by its real number. Sourced: the AIM-9 and the AIM-120 on 1 / 9, 2 / 8 and 3 / 7 (f16net-aim9, f16net-aim120); the GBU-31 on 3 / 7, one each, and the GBU-38 there two to a BRU-57/A (120.2 kg, l3h-bru57; f16net-jdam); three Mk 82 on a TER-9/A (47.6 kg, ter-9a) on 3 / 7, and on 4 / 6 (f16net-mk82, a forum: inferred; with tanks on 4 / 6 the real jet takes two on 3 / 7, not modelled); the 370 US gal tank on 4 / 6 (f16net-tanks) and the 600 US gal tank there (usaf-600). Inferred: the Python 5 on the AIM-9 rails 1 / 9 and 2 / 8 (a modified LAU-129; no station chart found); the Mk 83 and the Mk 84 one each on 3 / 7 and 4 / 6 (f16net-mk82 tells of four Mk 84); the SPICE 1000 / 2000 on 3 / 7 and 4 / 6 and the Delilah on 3 / 7 (no source gives their stations); the Sufa and the Barak the same (no source shows a difference). Station 5, the centreline, takes none of the inventory; each rack's rack_drag (drag index, flight-model.md §9.18) inferred as one of its stores' (a beam of about their cross-section)
notes.tail: the number painted on the Barak's model (shared/extra/models/f16/f16d.glb: the FlightGear F-16's IAF desert livery, tail 547), so every screen shows the jet the player sees (the user, 2026-11-13, A31). Until then 034 of 109 Squadron (ize-034); the squadron since then the livery's, 101 (the base file's `squadrons`; the user, 2026-11-13)
notes.max_takeoff_kg: the F-16C/D Block 40/42's maximum take-off weight, 42,300 lb (19,187 kg); the Barak is an F-16D Block 40
notes.type: the F-16's type code; the airframe definition f16 is the Barak's
notes.model: none: the player's jet is drawn from its airframe definition (shared/extra/planes/f16/airframe.json)
notes.scale: 1: our models are built true size
notes.radius_m: half the span over the wingtip rails, 9.96 m
notes.strength: our damage scale's fighter (modern-iaf/docs/data-formats.md, damage scale)
notes.loadout.20mm: M61A1, 511 rounds (the F-16's; the two-seat Barak's count is not published, inferred the same)
notes.loadout.chaff: no public count found; 60 held until one is
notes.loadout.flare: no public count found; 60 held until one is
notes.pylons: an AIM-9M on each wingtip rail (stations 1 and 9, A and I): the F-16's wingtip rails carry its short-range missiles (w-f16); a 370 US gal tank on each wing's inboard station (stations 4 and 6, D and F; the F-16's wing tanks, f16net-tanks), carried on most flights (inferred); no other underwing stores in training (inferred); an AIM-9M on each underwing missile station, 2 / 8 (B, H) and 3 / 7 (C, G): the F-16 carries AIM-9s and AIM-120s there (f16net-aim9, f16net-aim120); on 2 / 8 the AIM-9M stands in for the IAF's Python (inferred), on 3 / 7 for an AIM-120, which the sim has no record of yet (stand-ins, inferred)
notes.inventory: the stores the briefing lists as the jet's, each its own record in data/db/weapons with its sourced weight and size: the AIM-9M, the Python 5, the AIM-120, the Mk 82, Mk 83 and Mk 84, the GBU-31 and GBU-38 JDAM, the SPICE 1000 and 2000, the Delilah, the 370 and 600 US gal tanks; no counts published

footnotes.bms-asym: Falcon BMS forum, "Asymmetric loads - Air to Ground for F16" (quotes the F-16 flight manual, section 5: the maximum allowable asymmetric (rolling) moment for ground handling, taxi, takeoff, inflight and landing is 25,020 foot-pounds), https://forum.falcon-bms.com/post/167880

footnotes.usaf-600: USAF, "600 Gallon External Fuel Tank Assembly", solicitation FA8232-26-R-B014 (600 gal tanks on wing stations four and six), https://samsearch.co/gov-explore/federal/600-gallon-external-fuel-tank-assembly/FA8232-26-R-B014

footnotes.f16net-b40: F-16.net, "F-16 Block 40/42" (18,238 lb empty, 42,300 lb maximum takeoff), https://www.f-16.net/f-16_versions_article7.html
footnotes.model-547: the FlightGear F-16's Models/Liveries/Block40/90-0874.png, the IAF desert livery with tail 547 (shared/extra/models/f16/SOURCES.md), the Barak's model's paint
